title: Nim Conf 2026 (Online, Sat June 20)
summary: Nim Conf 2026 is an upcoming online conference dedicated to the Nim programming language, scheduled for June 20, 2026. The event serves as a platform for the Nim community to share knowledge, showcase projects, and discuss the future of the language.
problem_solved: Provides a centralized virtual event for Nim developers to learn, network, and stay updated on language developments.
why_valuable: Offers valuable learning and community-building opportunities for Nim programmers through talks, demos, and collaboration.
